actionable_steps.citation: Redeem your life by namasmarana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 35 (2002), 2002-04-14
actionable_steps.step: Begin right now — you need no musical instruments for it; it is enough if it originates from the core of your heart.

actionable_steps.citation: The message I bring — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 8 (1968), 1968-07-04
actionable_steps.step: Fix a set time every morning and evening in your home for spiritual reading and namasmarana — and keep it.

actionable_steps.citation: Hanumaan : the ideal for mankind — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28 (1995), 1995-10-14
actionable_steps.step: Pair the Name with service: chanting alone is not enough — be active in the service of the form behind the name.

actionable_steps.citation: The devotion that God loves — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 27 (1994), 1994-12-18
actionable_steps.step: Try likhita japam — writing the Name with mind, speech and hand united. A few names with sincere devotion beat pages written mechanically.

actionable_steps.citation: Auspiciousness (Sivam), Not Corpse (Savam) — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 3 (1963), 1963-04-29
actionable_steps.step: Fill the Name with your love and saturate it with devotion every time you repeat it — that is the easiest path.

definition.citation: Anything In Life Can Be Achieved With Faith In God — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 40 (2007), 2007-12-26
definition.quote: You may not be able to do japa, dhyana or yoga; but do namasmarana. There is no easier path than namasmarana to be in communion with God.

discourses.citation: Auspiciousness (Sivam), Not Corpse (Savam) — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 3 (1963), 1963-04-29
discourses.quote: Repetition of the Name (namasmarana) is the best spiritual discipline; it is the most beneficial good action. It is the highest prayer, the most profitable spiritual exercise. … Fill the Name with your love whenever you repeat it; saturate it with devotion. That is the easiest path for all of you.

discourses.citation: Redeem your life by namasmarana — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 35 (2002), 2002-04-14
discourses.quote: Whoever has a heart has the right to do namasmarana. The heart is the same in everyone. … Be he young or old, rich or poor, everyone has to do namasmarana.

discourses.citation: Hanumaan : the ideal for mankind — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 28 (1995), 1995-10-14
discourses.quote: Nama-Japa (chanting the name) is not enough. Whatever name you recite, you must also be active in the service of the form associated with the name.

discourses.citation: The obliterating flood — Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 7 (1967), 1967-04-24
discourses.quote: I will call it the deficiency of Vitamin G, and I will recommend the repetition of the Name of God, with accompanying contemplation of the glory and grace of God. That is the Vitamin G.

make_it_real: You need no instrument, no posture, no special occasion — just your tongue and your heart. Start the Name right now, and don't stop.
title: Namasmarana

vahinis.quote: Of the various types of devotion, remembrance of the name (nama-smarana) is best. In the Kali era (yuga), the name is the path for saving oneself. … There can be no better path to liberation (mukthi) than considering the name of the Lord as the very breath of life.
Through yoga and penance, extraordinary power; through remembrance of the name, repetition of the name, and meditation, extraordinary love — this is the difference between the two.
